detailZh: 劳森将在奥斯汀美国大奖赛之前进行现场音乐表演
劳森将与其兄弟和童年朋友们一起在奥斯汀的VCARB Garage 各节练习与排位进行现场表演
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
劳森将在下周的美国大奖赛之前成为奥斯汀VCARB Garage 各节练习与排位的头条现场表演者
新西兰人将在10月22日离开驾驶舱，在Inn Cahoots现场表演。这场名为“劳森 & Friends”的表演是Esses Bazaar活动的一部分，届时劳森将和他的兄弟Marcus以及童年好友Thomas和Harrison一同登台。
名单上还有乡村歌手/词曲作者Jonny Capeci、Scoot Teasley和Jess Farren，以及新兴人才Alison Nichols和Drake Milligan。
“这是一种你永远感觉不到完全准备好的情况。你总是可以做更多，但我有一个非常具体的工作，这很难融入我的日常中，”当被问及为现场表演做准备时的挑战时，劳森对小红牛说。
他还补充说，能够和他的兄弟以及童年好友一起表演“非常酷”。“我很兴奋，但也很紧张。有我的兄弟和童年好友陪伴我，自从我八岁起我们就一起玩耍，这真的很酷。”
24岁的车手也分享了他的音乐灵感："我从小就听我爸的音乐。主要是80年代的摇滚乐。我第一次去音乐会看的是Def Leppard，当时我八九岁。"
"我爸告诉我，如果我通过吉他考试并获得优异成绩，他就让我去，我做到了。成长过程中，John Mayer也是我的灵感来源。他非常出色，他的音乐知识和歌曲创作都很有意思。我喜欢那些老歌。"
这发生在劳森一个令人印象深刻的赛季中。他目前在车手积分榜上排名第九，积分为75分。小红牛以100分排名第五。
美国大奖赛将于10月23日至25日在美国赛车场举行。
detailEn: Liam Lawson to perform live music set ahead of F1 United States Grand Prix in Austin
Liam Lawson is set to perform live alongside his brother and childhood friends at the VCARB Garage Sessions in Austin
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Liam Lawson will headline the live VCARB Garage Sessions in Austin ahead of the United States Grand Prix next weekend.

The New Zealander will step away from the cockpit to perform live at Inn Cahoots on 22 October. Billed as "Liam Lawson & Friends", the performance forms part of the Esses Bazaar event and will see Lawson joined on stage by his brother, Marcus, alongside childhood friends Thomas and Harrison.
Also on the line-up are country singer/songwriters Jonny Capeci, Scoot Teasley and Jess Farren, alongside up-and-coming talents Alison Nichols and Drake Milligan.

"It’s one of those situations where you never feel fully prepared. You can always do more, but I have such a specific job that this can be difficult to fit into my routine," Lawson told Racing Bulls when asked about the challenges of preparing for a live performance.

He added that it is "pretty cool" to be able to perform alongside his brother and childhood friends. "Excited, but also very, very nervous. To have my brother and childhood friends with me, who I’ve played with since I was eight years old, is pretty cool."
The 24-year-old also shared some of his musical inspirations: "I grew up listening to my dad’s music. 80s rock, mainly. The first concert I went to was Def Leppard when I was eight or nine.

"My dad told me that if I passed my guitar exam with a distinction, he’d let me go, and I did. Growing up, John Mayer was an inspiration too. He’s very good and his music knowledge and songwriting are very cool. I like the older stuff."
This comes during an impressive season for Lawson. He currently sits ninth in the drivers' standings with 75 points. Racing Bulls is fifth with 100 points.
The United States Grand Prix will take place at the Circuit of the Americas from 23-25 October.

items.originalTitle: Colton Herta eyes potential Indy 500 return and IMSA enduros as 2027 plans remain in flux
detailZh: 科顿·赫塔展望2027年可能重返印第安纳波利斯500赛事和IMSA耐力赛，但计划仍处于变动之中
超级执照的追求是首要任务，但这位加州本土车手明确表示，如果日程允许，他不会拒绝印第安纳波利斯500的席位或IMSA耐力赛的驾驶机会
科顿·赫塔的2027年赛车计划尚未确定，但这位凯迪拉克一级方程式测试车手渴望在日程允许的情况下重返印第安纳波利斯500和IMSA耐力赛。这位26岁的加州本土车手，目前正在Hitech车队完成他在FIA二级方程式锦标赛的首个赛季，尚未确定明年的计划
随着他的职业道路聚焦于获得一级方程式所需的FIA超级执照，赫塔即将到来的承诺将决定他是否能够重返美国主要赛车赛事的阵容，包括‘500’和IMSA WeatherTech体育车手锦标赛的耐力赛轮次。
赫塔，在IndyCar系列赛中赢得了九场比赛，并在2024年获得了亚军，从2019年到2025年连续参加了七届印第安纳波利斯500赛事，原计划在今年5月驾驶安德里蒂全球车队的一辆赛车，但由于FIA在蒙特利尔增加了一站Formula 2赛事，以取代巴林和沙特阿拉伯取消的比赛，导致日程安排发生重大变动，这让他感到非常痛苦。
回顾这次错失的机会以及他对“赛车界最伟大的盛事”的渴望，赫塔明确表示，如果他的日程允许，他将在2027年参赛。
“是的，我永远不会拒绝参加印第安纳波利斯500，”赫塔对Motorsport.com说。“我总是想参加印第安纳波利斯500。今年没能参加真是太遗憾了。你知道，一切都已经安排好了。”
当被问及这个破坏性的日程变动如何打乱了他的5月计划时，他补充说：“是的，这打乱了所有计划。但这是不可避免的，不幸的是，它没有发生。我不知道我明年的情况会怎样。但如果我有机会，100%我会想参加印第安纳波利斯500。”
#40 凯迪拉克 Wayne Taylor Racing 凯迪拉克 V-Series.R：乔丹·泰勒，路易斯·德莱特拉斯，科尔顿·赫塔
赫塔目前在F2积分榜上排名第19位，本赛季最佳成绩是在巴塞罗那短道赛中获得第五名，此外还有四次进入前八名。当前的F2赛历以连续两轮在卡塔尔（11月28日至29日）和阿布扎比（12月5日至6日）结束，尽管这些赛事在中东地区2月份开始的地区冲突中已经面临了几个月的不确定性。
除了单座赛车外，赫塔本赛季还作为Wayne Taylor Racing耐力车队的成员，在#40凯迪拉克车上参与了赛车运动，并在Petit Le Mans赛事中获得了领奖台的成绩。他明年能否继续在主要的发展任务之外平衡赛车出场的可能性尚未确定。
“如果由我来决定，我会尽可能多地尝试……尽可能多地参加三项耐力赛事（戴通纳24小时耐力赛、摩比1十二小时赛布林格和Petit Le Mans），”赫塔关于他的赛车前景说道。
“我真的很喜欢这个……我看了所有的比赛，所以我不错过这些人的任何一场比赛。成为其中一员很有趣，但如果由我来决定，我会百分之百尝试回到比赛中。但是，你知道，我认为这完全取决于明年会是什么样子，而这，我还不清楚。”
detailEn: Colton Herta eyes potential Indy 500 return and IMSA enduros as 2027 plans remain in flux
Super License pursuits take priority, but the California native makes clear he won't turn down an Indy 500 seat or IMSA endurance drives if calendar space opens up

Colton Herta’s 2027 racing plans remain undecided, but the Cadillac Formula 1 test driver is eager to return to both the Indianapolis 500 and IMSA endurance races if his schedule allows. The 26-year-old California native, currently completing his debut campaign in the FIA Formula 2 Championship with Hitech, has yet to finalize his program for next year.

With his career path focused on securing the FIA Super License required for Formula 1, Herta's upcoming commitment will dictate whether he can rejoin the grid for America's major motorsports events, including the '500' and the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship endurance rounds.

Herta, who amassed nine wins in his IndyCar Series career and finished as championship runner-up in 2024, made seven consecutive starts in the Indianapolis 500 from 2019 through 2025,  He was slated to pilot a fourth entry for Andretti Global this past May, but a late calendar upheaval – prompted by the FIA adding a Formula 2 round in Montreal alongside the Formula 1 Canadian Grand Prix to replace canceled events in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia – forced a heartbreaking conflict.
Reflecting on the missed opportunity and his appetite for “The Greatest Spectacle in Racing,” Herta left no ambiguity about his intentions if his calendar permits in 2027.
“Yeah, I’ll never turn down the Indy 500,” Herta told Motorsport.com. “I always want to do the Indy 500. It was a shame this year that I couldn't do it. You know, it was all set up.”

Asked about the disruptive late schedule change that derailed his May plans, he added: “Yes, and that threw everything out. But it was going to happen and unfortunately it didn’t. I don’t know what next year looks like for me. But if I get the chance, 100 percent, I would love to do the Indy 500.”
#40 Cadillac Wayne Taylor Racing Cadillac V-Series.R: Jordan Taylor, Louis Deletraz, Colton Herta

Herta currently sits 19th in the F2 standings, with a season-best finish of fifth in the Barcelona Sprint Race alongside four additional top-eight results. The current F2 calendar concludes with back-to-back rounds in Qatar (November 28–29) and Abu Dhabi (December 5–6), though those events have faced months of uncertainty amid regional conflicts in the Middle East that began in February.

Beyond single-seaters, Herta has embedded himself in sports car racing this season as part of Wayne Taylor Racing’s endurance lineup in the #40 Cadillac, and is fresh off a podium result at Petit Le Mans. Whether he can continue balancing sports car appearances alongside his primary development duties next year remains undecided.

“If it was up to me, I would try to do as much as possible… as much as possible doing the three endurance races (Rolex 24 At Daytona, Mobil 1 Twelve Hours of Sebring, and Petit Le Mans),” Herta said regarding his sports car prospects.

“I really enjoy that... I watch all the races, so I don't miss a race from these guys. It's a lot of fun to be a part of it, but if it's up to me, 100 percent I will try to be back in doing races. But, you know, I think it all depends on what next year looks like, which I just, I don't know yet.”

items.originalTitle: F1 fan brings Rwanda's future grand prix circuit to life in "Assetto Corsa" simulation
detailZh: F1粉丝在"Assetto Corsa"模拟器中重现卢旺达未来大奖赛赛道
一位粉丝在F1宣布与非洲签订长达十年的赛事协议后，仅用72小时就在Assetto Corsa模拟器中重现了卢旺达的拟议F1赛道。
Motorsport文化超越赛道本身。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车运动不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
在F1宣布与非洲签订长达十年的赛事协议后，一位用户制作的赛道内摄像头记录的视频开始在网络上流传，展示了卢旺达未来大奖赛赛道的场景。
这是从驾驶舱内对赛道感受的有趣一瞥，但它只是基于F1迄今为止发布的单一预览图像的业余爱好者的最佳猜测，并非真实布局。所以请记住这一点。
修改者名为Nukedrop，西班牙F1账号Nachez在X上发布了这段视频。屏幕录制视频获得了大约695个赞，吸引了41,000名观众，最初在Reddit的Formula1版块出现。
Nukedrop在YouTube的描述中提到，这个修改是在“过去24小时左右”内创建的。他通过将F1渲染背景中的机场与卫星图像匹配来放置赛道，然后使用了周围景观的真实海拔数据。这个模拟使用了一辆涂有当前红白车身的法拉利，车号为44 - 汉密尔顿的赛车 - 七届冠军的黄色头盔在屏幕底部刚刚露出，它在桥下穿行并跨越了多彩的赛道边缘。
Tyrone Hesbrook以Nukedrop的别名在Assetto Corsa社区中确立了自己作为一位杰出的赛道创作者的地位，他之前的作品包括派克峰和独立设计的赛道，如Circuit Thermalito。
不要把它与其他粉丝的努力混淆。Romeo Gagliotti的“Rwanda International Circuit”模组是一个虚构的5.3公里顺时针布局，TC Esports在F1 25游戏中发布了非官方版本。
Nukedrop的赛道长度仅为4.65公里——比官方设计师描述的大约6公里布局短了1.35公里。官方赛道将有17个弯道，并逆时针行驶。完整的布局尚未公布，Nukedrop承认他的版本涉及“大量关于比例、海拔和隐藏细节的推测”。
海拔甚至更难以理解。Wurz计算出的圈数为197米的垂直海拔上升，而粉丝制作的版本在整个赛道上大约有70米的海拔变化。这些不是相同的测量，所以两者都可以是正确的：赛道可以总共上升197米，但底部到顶部的跨度只有70米。
WurzDesign与Tilke Engineering合作，在基加利以南大约40公里的Bugesera开发赛道，靠近一个预计将于2028年开放的机场。赛道蜿蜒穿过高地地形，穿过湖边区域，拥有倾斜的弯道，并包含一条超过1公里的高速直道，直道将在一个旨在促进超车的紧弯道结束。
车臣·蒂尔克表示，坡度达到12-13%，而沃兹将结果称为“像过山车一样，真正独特”。
沃兹已经通过模拟完成了无数圈，而且虚拟赛道也由活跃的一级方程式车手进行了测试。这与一个基于新闻渲染图的修改者进行的研究标准略有不同，尽管粉丝版本先到，Nukedrop的Patreon支持者已经可以下载了。
由于第一场比赛要到2030年代初才举行，我们将猜测多年。在完整布局发布之前，Assetto Corsa中的法拉利将是大多数我们能接触到的最接近的东西。
detailEn: F1 fan brings Rwanda's future grand prix circuit to life in "Assetto Corsa" simulation
A fan has recreated Rwanda's proposed Formula 1 circuit in Assetto Corsa just days after the historic grand prix announcement
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Within 72 hours of Formula 1 revealing a decade-long deal to race in Africa, footage from a user-created onboard camera recording of Rwanda’s future grand prix venue began circulating online.

It’s a fun look at what the track could feel like from the cockpit, but it’s a hobbyist’s best guess created from the single preview image F1 has released so far, not the real layout. So bear that in mind.

The modder is Nukedrop, and Spanish F1 account Nachez spread the clip on X. The screen recording accumulated approximately 695 likes and reached 41,000 viewers, having initially surfaced in the Formula1 section of Reddit.

The mod, created within the Assetto Corsa game, was built in “the last 24 or so hours”, according to Nukedrop’s YouTube description. He placed the circuit by matching the airport in the background of F1’s render to satellite imagery, then used real elevation data for the surrounding landscape. The simulation uses a Ferrari bearing its current red-and-white livery and the number 44 - Hamilton’s car - with the seven-time champion’s yellow helmet just poking out at the bottom of the screen as it navigates beneath a bridge and across multi-hued track kerbing.

Tyrone Hesbrook, using the Nukedrop alias, has established himself as a prominent circuit creator in the Assetto Corsa community, with previous work spanning Pikes Peak and independently designed tracks including Circuit Thermalito.

Don’t confuse it with the other fan efforts. Romeo Gagliotti’s “Rwanda International Circuit” mod is a fictional 5.3km clockwise layout, and TC Esports has posted an unofficial version in the F1 25 game.

Nukedrop’s track measures just 4.65km - about 1.35km short of the roughly 6km layout the official designers describe. The official circuit will have 17 corners and run anti-clockwise. The full layout is yet to be published, and Nukedrop admits his version involves “plenty of educated guesses about scale, elevation and details hidden from view”.

Elevation is even trickier to understand. Wurz has calculated the lap to involve 197m of vertical elevation gain, whereas the fan-built version accounts for roughly 70m of altitude variation across the circuit. Those aren’t the same measurement, so both can be right: a track can climb 197m in total yet only span 70m from bottom to top.

WurzDesign, collaborating with Tilke Engineering, is developing the circuit in Bugesera, roughly 40km south of Kigali near an airport that is due to open in 2028. The track weaves through elevated terrain, runs through a lakeside section, features cambered corners, and contains a high-speed straight exceeding 1km that will end in a tight corner meant to facilitate passing.
Carsten Tilke says gradients reach 12-13%, and Wurz calls the result “like a roller coaster and truly unique”.

Wurz has completed numerous laps through simulation, and the virtual layout has been tested by active F1 drivers as well. That’s a slightly different standard of research from a modder working off a press render, though the fan version arrived first, and Nukedrop’s Patreon supporters can already download it.
With the first race not due until the early 2030s, we’ll be speculating for years. Until the full layout is released, a Ferrari in Assetto Corsa is as close as most of us will get.

在摩纳哥公国，一辆蓝色的法拉利 849 Testarossa 从蒙特卡洛经销商开出是一件很平常的事情。但最近一位摩纳哥籍影响者发布的一段视频显示，哈斯一级方程式车手奥利·贝尔曼正在驾驶这辆新的法拉利超跑。这样的画面在撰写本文时已经获得了大约 5,600 个赞和 79 个分享，并不令人意外。
在视频中，一辆蓝色849号赛车，车身带有白色赛车条纹和黄色刹车卡钳——带有摩纳哥注册标志——从蒙特卡洛法拉利经销商驶出。
Instagram上的帖子标题称这位年轻的英国人是‘测试’这辆车，但这尚未得到确认。私人经销商的试驾或车辆贷款安排更可能发生。
法拉利于2025年9月9日推出了这款车型，作为SF90 Stradale的插电式混合动力继任者。2026年中旬开始于马拉内洛生产这些车型。动力来自一台4.0升双涡轮增压V8发动机，产生830 约819马力。
三个电动机，两个在前，一个在后，额外提供220 PS。总功率为1,050 马力，比SF90多出50 PS，并且非常接近2026年F1赛车的功率。
八速双离合变速器将动力传递到所有四个车轮，法拉利声称其0-100公里/小时加速时间仅需2.3秒。最高速度约为330公里/小时，或205英里/小时。7.45千瓦时的电池可提供大约26公里（16英里）的纯电动行驶里程，足以安静地行驶到港口。
它可以购买为双门轿跑车或配备可折叠硬顶的敞篷车，定价完全在一级方程式车手薪水范围内，轿跑车起价约为46万欧元，敞篷车起价约为50万欧元。
名字中的“八”代表汽缸数量，而“49”代表每个汽缸的排量，略小于500cc。“Testarossa”这个名字复活了1950年代的法拉利赛车和著名的1980年代超级跑车。设计元素参考了F80超跑和达喀尔，法拉利将车的后部与1970年的512S耐力赛车相比较。
条纹看起来像是一种涂装选择。它们可能会让你想称它为以赛道为重点的Assetto Fiorano套件，该套件适用于两种车身样式和多种配置，增加了大约30公斤的重量。但如果没有查看配置器，我只能猜测。
为什么一位法拉利的青训车手会驾驶这样的赛车
贝尔曼是法拉利车手学院的一员，并代表法拉利引擎的哈斯车队参赛。他在F1的首场比赛中，在2024年沙特阿拉伯大奖赛中替换了因手术而缺席的卡洛斯·塞恩斯，在那里他完成了令人印象深刻的第七名。
detailEn: Ollie Bearman spotted driving 1,000hp+ Ferrari supercar through Monaco
The Haas F1 driver was filmed leaving a Monaco dealership behind the wheel of Ferrari's latest supercar
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

A blue Ferrari 849 Testarossa pulling out of a Monte Carlo dealership is a normal thing in the principality of Monaco. But a recent video from a Monaco-based influencer shows Haas Formula 1 driver Ollie Bearman driving the new Ferrari supercar. It comes as no surprise that such a view has generated approximately 5,600 likes and 79 shares at the time of writing.
In the video, a blue 849 wearing white racing stripes and yellow brake calipers - bearing a Monaco registration - exits the Scuderia Monte-Carlo, a Ferrari retailer.
While the caption of the Instagram post says the young Briton is 'testing' the car, this hasn't been confirmed. A private dealership test drive or vehicle loan arrangement would be more plausible.

Ferrari introduced the car on 9 September 2025 as the plug-in hybrid successor to the SF90 Stradale. The building of the cars at Maranello started in mid-2026. Power is shovelled from a 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 producing 830 PS - around 819 horsepower.

Three electric motors, two up front and one at the rear, add an additional 220 PS. The total is 1,050 PS (1,036 hp), which is 50 PS more than the SF90 managed and very close to what a 2026 F1 car produces.

An eight-speed dual-clutch gearbox sends power to all four wheels, and Ferrari claims a 0-100 km/h time of just 2.3 seconds. Top speed sits at around 330 km/h, or 205 mph. The 7.45 kWh battery is good for roughly 26 km (16 miles) of electric driving, enough for a silent run down to the harbour.

It can be bought as a coupe or as a Spider with a folding hard top, and pricing sits well and truly within F1 driver salary territory, starting at around €460,000 for the coupe and €500,000 for the Spider.

The "eight" in the name is for the cylinder count, and "49" is each cylinder's displacement, just under 500cc. "Testarossa" revives a 1950s Ferrari racer and the famous 1980s supercar. Design elements reference both the F80 hypercar and the Daytona, with Ferrari comparing the rear of the car to that of the 1970 512S endurance car.

The stripes look like a livery choice. They might tempt you to call it the track-focused Assetto Fiorano pack, which is offered on both body styles and trims about 30 kg of fat. But without a look at the configurator, I can only guess.
Why a Ferrari junior would be driving one

Bearman is a member of the Ferrari Driver Academy and competes with the Ferrari-powered Haas squad. His first race in F1 saw him replace a surgery-stricken Carlos Sainz at the 2024 Saudi Arabian Grand Prix, where he finished an impressive seventh.

items.originalTitle: The United States Grand Prix is getting a bizarre new attraction
detailZh: 美国大奖赛将迎来奇特新景观
官方将在美国大奖赛前的周四检查建设情况
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
一级方程式已经带给我们介于赌场之间的街道赛道、维修区隧道和设有假码头的停车场。现在，美国赛车场希望展示世界上最大的牛仔帽，内部还设有酒吧，并希望吉尼斯世界纪录能注意到这一创举。
这将在即将到来的美国大奖赛上发生，届时一名吉尼斯世界纪录官员将在比赛周末之前于周四检查这座建筑的建造情况。
COTA总裁鲍比·爱泼斯坦确认了这座巨无霸的尺寸。它由玻璃纤维制成，高度为75英尺——大约23米——内部将设有以西部为主题的酒吧，从Lone Star Land进入，这是为观众建造的赛道一部分。据信这座建筑的建造工作即将完成。
“我认为赛道应该有一个带有某种吉尼斯世界纪录的旅游景点，”爱泼斯坦告诉《The Athletic》。他希望有一个地标，即使F1赛事不在镇上，人们也能认出来。“与其建一个普通的帐篷，为什么不建一个75英尺高的牛仔帽呢？”
公平地说，我们大多数人都会满足于帐篷。
没有现存的吉尼斯世界纪录追踪最大的牛仔帽——也许并不令人意外，这意味着如果科塔确实被吉尼斯认证为纪录尝试，它可能开始这个类别。爱泼斯坦还预计这顶帽子将全年留在场地，而不仅仅是为一级方程式赛车而竖立。
如果你还没去过，孤星州土地是科塔的牧场主题粉丝区。这个赛道以传统的西部美学而受到全州的欢迎，粉丝区经常举办诸如行列舞和绳索演示等表演，偶尔还会在混合中扔进一顶斯特森帽。
对于德克萨斯州来说，有多大才算大？
这顶帽子在当地有一些竞争。圣安东尼奥的福克斯新闻报道，最大的牛仔靴雕塑高达10.74米，所以科塔的帽子将比它高大约一倍。吉尼斯还在2012年记录了在天使体育场有39,013人戴着牛仔帽，这是科塔看台有机会与之匹敌的聚会，如果每个人都记得带上斯特森帽的话。
奥斯汀还发生了什么？
这个周末，基米·安东内利可能在奥斯汀获得冠军头衔，威廉姆斯车队计划在粉丝区展示其漫威主题的展示车。您可以点击以下链接了解更多。
detailEn: The United States Grand Prix is getting a bizarre new attraction
An official will inspect the construction on Thursday before the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Formula 1 has given us street circuits between casinos, a pitlane tunnel, and a paddock with a fake marina. Now the Circuit of the Americas wants the world's largest cowboy hat, complete with a bar inside, and it's hoping Guinness World Records might take note of it.
This will all happen at the upcoming United States Grand Prix, where a Guinness official will inspect the build on the Thursday ahead of the race weekend.

COTA president Bobby Epstein has confirmed the dimensions of this behemoth. Built from fibreglass, it will be 75 feet in height - roughly 23 metres - and inside will feature a Western-themed bar with access from Lone Star Land, a part of the circuit built for spectators. The construction of the thing is understood to be close to being finished.

"I thought the circuit should have a tourist attraction with some kind of Guinness World Record," Epstein told The Athletic. He wanted a landmark people would recognise even when the F1 circus isn't in town. "Instead of a regular tent, why not build a 75-foot cowboy hat?"
Fair enough. Most of us would have settled for the tent.

No existing Guinness World Record tracks the largest cowboy hat - maybe unsurprisingly, meaning COTA could start the category if it is indeed verified as a record attempt by Guinness. Epstein also expects that the hat will stay at the venue year-round rather than just go up for the F1 race.

If you haven't been, Lone Star Land is COTA's ranch-themed fan zone. The circuit has embraced traditional Western aesthetics with it being so popular across the state, and the fan zone often hosts performances such as line dancing and rope demonstrations, along with the odd Stetson hat thrown in the mix.
How big is big, even for Texas?

The hat has some local competition. Fox San Antonio reports the largest cowboy boot sculpture stands 10.74 metres tall in San Antonio, so COTA's hat would tower over it at roughly double the height. Guinness has also recorded 39,013 people wearing cowboy hats at Angel Stadium in Anaheim in 2012. That's a gathering COTA's grandstands would have a decent shot at matching, if everyone remembered to bring a Stetson.
What else is happening in Austin?
The weekend may see Kimi Antonelli secure a championship title in Austin, and Williams plans to display its Marvel-themed show car in the fan zone. You can read about that by clicking below.

detailZh: 查恩多克对梅赛德斯F1升级性能表示担忧
前F1车手查恩多克警告梅赛德斯，其最新的空气动力学升级未能带来预期的性能提升。
对于梅赛德斯粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析。
天空体育评论员和前F1车手查恩多克认为，梅赛德斯应该对其最新的升级包表示担忧，警告称新的空气动力学部件未能带来预期的性能飞跃。
尽管基米·安东内利正在逼近他个人的首个车手总冠军，但在最近几场比赛中，梅赛德斯的表现已经趋于平稳。红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘在马来西亚和新加坡的最近两场大奖赛中获胜，而布拉克利车队在解锁其升级版W17的速度方面遇到了困难。
在天空体育F1节目中，钱德拉霍克表示，新加坡大奖赛对梅赛德斯来说并不是一个‘压倒性的积极’周末。安东内利在大奖赛中排名第三，而因为动力单元组件更换的网格处罚，拉塞尔从第19位起步，最终排名第9。
意大利车手在滨海湾街道赛道上驾驶升级后的赛车，而拉塞尔则使用的是之前的规格。尽管安东内利的表现优于他的队友，钱德拉霍克声称性能的提升还不够。
‘说实话，我认为在那个方面，这对他们来说并不是一个压倒性的积极周末。周五的时候，乔治驾驶的降级版赛车更快，’这位前车手解释道。
“当我们进入主排位赛时，乔治在冲刺赛中发生事故后显然有些落后，他说他只是试图在排位赛中安全地完成比赛并做一份明智的工作。说实话，他和基米相差并不远。”
“那么，空气动力学升级是否带来了很大的性能提升？我认为你可以说可能没有，在马来西亚和新加坡都没有。所以，我认为他们可能会有些担心。”
安东内利目前以340分领跑车手积分榜。拉塞尔以238分排在第二位，法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿以229分位居第三。因此，梅赛德斯以578分领先车队积分榜。法拉利以444分排在第二位，而麦克拉伦以339分排在第三位。”
detailEn: Karun Chandhok raises concerns about Mercedes F1 upgrade performance
Former F1 driver Karun Chandhok has warned that Mercedes should be concerned after its latest aerodynamic upgrades
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Sky Sports pundit and former Formula 1 driver Karun Chandhok believes Mercedes should be "concerned" by its latest upgrade package, warning that the new aerodynamic parts have failed to deliver the desired jump in performance.

Despite Kimi Antonelli closing in on his maiden drivers' championship title, Mercedes' form has plateaued in recent races. As Red Bull's Max Verstappen won the last two grands prix in Malaysia and Singapore, the Brackley outfit struggled to unlock pace from its updated W17.

Speaking on the Sky Sports F1 Show, Chandhok claimed the Singapore Grand Prix was not an "overwhelmingly positive" weekend for Mercedes. Antonelli finished third in the grand prix, while Russell, who started 19th due to grid penalties for power unit component changes, finished ninth.

The Italian driver was running in the upgraded machinery at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, while Russell was using the previous specification. Although Antonelli outperformed his team-mate, Chandhok claimed the improvement in performance was not enough.
"I don't think it was an overwhelmingly positive weekend for them in that respect, if I'm honest. On the Friday, the downgraded car was quicker with George," the former driver explained.

"When we got into the main qualifying, George was slightly on the back foot, obviously after the crash in the sprint. He said he was just trying to get a safe run through quali and do a sensible job. He wasn't that far off Kimi, to be honest.
"So, has the aero upgrade delivered a big chunk of performance? I think you'd have to say probably not, not in Malaysia nor in Singapore. So, I think they'll be a bit concerned."

Antonelli currently leads the drivers' standings with 340 points. Russell follows in second with 238 points, and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton sits third with 229 points. As a result, Mercedes also leads the constructors' championship with 578 points. Ferrari is second with 444 points and McLaren is third with 339 points.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫在新加坡大奖赛上佩戴了两块豪华IWC手表，以便设置不同的时区。
这不是沃尔夫第一次佩戴两块手表，得益于梅赛德斯赞助商IWC Schaffhausen的支持，这肯定不会是最后一次。
梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫在新加坡大奖赛上吸引了众多目光，他佩戴的两块豪华IWC手表成为了焦点。
梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫在新加坡大奖赛上佩戴了两块手表，这并不是他第一次这样做。
沃尔夫戴了两块手表，这样他就可以将它们设置为不同的时区。一块设置为新加坡时间，另一块设置为欧洲时间。这样，他就可以在知道确切时间的情况下，应对紧张夜间比赛的压力，无论是他在布拉克莱的家人所在的地方，还是可能是在摩纳哥，他的家人也住在那里。
沃尔夫已经这样做了很长时间。他与IWC的合作关系让他在本届新加坡大奖赛周末佩戴了IWC大飞行员系列防震表XPL Toto Wolff版。这块44毫米的计时器由Ceratanium制成，全球仅限量100块，旨在承受甚至最强烈的奥地利办公桌撞击——沃尔夫之前就因这一点而闻名。
第二块手表看起来像是IWC的新款飞行员系列计时码表41 梅赛德斯-AMG Petronas一级方程式车队版，这是品牌为纪念今年新加坡大奖赛而制作的。
它的紫色日出表盘灵感来源于新加坡的国花万代兰，搭配Petronas绿色的数字和标记、黑色指针以及相匹配的紫色橡胶表带。乔治·拉塞尔和基米·安东内利今年早些时候协助了该表的发布。
它不仅仅是一种车队色彩的搭配。这款41毫米的5级钛金属表壳搭载了IWC自产的69385自动计时码表机芯，46小时的动力储备通过蓝宝石底盖清晰可见，防水深度达到100米。然而，与沃尔夫的100件大型飞行员表不同，它并非限量版。它是IWC永久收藏的一部分，售价为7700瑞士法郎。

detailEn: Why Toto Wolff wore two watches at the Singapore Grand Prix
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff turned heads by wearing two luxury IWC watches at the Singapore Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Toto Wolff arrived at the Singapore Grand Prix last weekend with not one, but two watches strapped to his left wrist. This isn't the first time he's worn two watches, and, thanks to Mercedes sponsor IWC Schaffhausen, it certainly won't be the last.

Wolff wore two watches so he could set them to different time zones. One was set to Singapore time, and the other to European time. This way, he could juggle the pressures of the tight night race while knowing exactly what time it was back in Brackley, or potentially Monaco, where his family live.

Wolff has been doing this for a long time. His partnership with IWC led him to don the Big Pilot's Watch Shock Absorber XPL Toto Wolff edition throughout the Singapore Grand Prix weekend. This 44 mm timepiece, built from Ceratanium and restricted to just 100 units globally, is made to withstand even the strongest of Austrian desk slams - something Wolff has previously been known for.
The second watch appeared to be IWC’s new Pilot’s Watch Chronograph 41 Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team, which the brand created as a tribute to this year’s Singapore Grand Prix.

Its purple sunburst dial is inspired by the Vanda Miss Joaquim orchid, Singapore’s national flower, and is paired with Petronas-green numerals and markers, black hands and a matching purple rubber strap. George Russell and Kimi Antonelli assisted with the launch earlier this year.

It’s more than a team-colours tie-in. The 41mm grade 5 titanium case holds IWC’s in-house calibre 69,385 automatic chronograph, with a 46-hour power reserve visible through a sapphire cashback, and it’s water-resistant to 100m. Unlike Wolff’s 100-piece Big Pilot, however, it isn’t a limited edition. It’s part of IWC’s permanent collection and costs CHF 7,700.

detailZh: 谁将赢得今年终极F1梦想门票？由你决定……
今年喜力F1赛季门票的决赛选手名单已经确定——现在F1粉丝可以选出他们想要追随的人
在数百份大奖赛终极奖品的申请之后，喜力x F1赛季门票已经缩减至六位决赛选手——现在F1粉丝可以投票决定谁将获胜。
这些候选人来自英国、新西兰、新加坡、捷克和美国——他们都已经提出了他们一生中冒险的提案，其中一位将获得免费旅行、住宿以及下赛季每场F1比赛的通行证。
全球的F1粉丝被挑战分享他们对这项运动的热情，并解释为什么他们比任何人都值得获得一个难忘的赛季，体验独特的事件，与粉丝建立联系并亲眼目睹比赛。
这项活动由喜力设计，旨在展示通过共同的运动热情可以形成的联系，证明了‘粉丝拥有更多朋友’的理念。
F1粉丝布兰登·伯格是首位获得金色门票的人，他在本赛季已经将他的一些故事分享给了他社交媒体上的近15万名粉丝。他的旅程现在即将结束——现在是时候选择下一个‘明星’来接替他的位置了。
参赛名单展示了这项运动的全球粉丝基础和比赛的巨大影响力——最后六位都有独特的故事要讲述，都有不同的理由让他们值得那个特别的奖项。
Callum，来自苏格兰，小时候曾在电视前假装自己是迈克尔·舒马赫。他是一位热衷于电影摄影的人，并表示：“我希望能带你看看F1赛季票背后的场景，用电影记录F1的人和地方。”
新西兰人Dale表示，他想要探索每一场比赛背后的“F1世界”，了解独特的人物、文化和粉丝。“我想遇见那些让它变得特别的人，并带大家一起体验这份乐趣，”他说。
住在捷克共和国的Lukas表示，赢得奖品将“终于给我的沙发带来一些宁静”并承诺粉丝，他们可以通过为他选择每个周末要参加的挑战来“成为车队老板”，随着赛季的进行分享结果。
来自英国的India称自己是一个“完全普通的粉丝”，希望明年能变得“非凡”，并要求其他粉丝为每场比赛给她设定有趣的挑战，表示赢得比赛将“将我对F1和环游世界的两个激情结合起来。”
Joy，她的家乡新加坡的比赛在本月早些时候举行，她希望利用这次机会体验“全球F1的激动和体育精神”，并有机会与周围的人“分享同样的热情”。
Jose来自美国，他不仅是赛车迷，还迷上了F1背后的策略、技术和团队合作。他去年参观了他在拉斯维加斯的家乡比赛，并表示：“如果能在2027年每场比赛都去旅行，那将真的是梦想成真。”
前往每个大奖赛的机会为这项运动及其粉丝打开了前所未有的接触途径。当前的票持有者Burgess已经展示了如何在这个赛季充分利用这次经历，并且他曾是挑选候选人名单的评审团成员。
在比赛开始前，他说：“我将关注的重点是F1的热情，因为只有真正的粉丝才能充分利用这次机会。放弃它将会很困难，而且选择下一个人的压力相当大。”
比赛面向25岁及以上的粉丝开放，参赛者被要求说出他们最喜欢的车队和车手，并从F1和喜力提供的选项中选择他们愿意带去未来比赛的选手。
然后随机选取了50名参赛者，邀请他们提交一个90秒的视频，说明为什么他们应该成为下一个票证持有者——现在有六个最终视频可供观看，所以粉丝可以决定谁应该赢得这一终身冒险的机会。

detailEn: Who will win this year’s ultimate F1 dream ticket? You decide…
The shortlist of finalists for this year’s Heineken F1 Season Ticket has been set – now F1 fans can choose who they want to follow
After hundreds of applications for the ultimate prize in grand prix racing, the Heineken x F1 Season Ticket is down to six finalists – and F1 fans can now vote to decide who wins.

The candidates – from the UK, New Zealand, Singapore, Czechia and the USA – have all put their pitches forward for the adventure of a lifetime, which will see one of them get free travel, accommodation and passes for every single F1 race next season.

The competition challenged F1 fans around the world to share their passion for the sport and explain why they, more than anyone, deserve to be gifted an unforgettable season of racing, experiencing unique events, connecting with fans and watching the action first hand.
The initiative was designed by Heineken to showcase the connections that can be formed through a shared passion for the sport, demonstrating that ‘Fans Have More Friends.’

F1 fan Brandon Burgess was the first recipient of the golden ticket and has been posting his stories to almost 150,000 followers on his social channels this season. His journey has now almost run its course – and now it is time to choose the next ‘star’ to take over his mantle.

The list of entries demonstrates the sport’s global fanbase and the massive reach of the competition – and the final six all have a unique story to tell, with a different reason why they deserve that special prize.

Callum, from Scotland, used to pretend to be Michael Schumacher in front of the TV when he was a toddler. He’s a keen film photographer and says: “I’d love to take you behind the scenes of the F1 season ticket and show you the people and places of F1 on film.”

New Zealander, Dale, says he wants to discover the “F1 world” behind every race, exploring the unique people, cultures and fans. “I want to meet the people who make it special and bring everyone along for the ride,” he says.

Lukas, who lives in Czechia, says winning the prize would “finally be some peace for my sofa” and promises fans they can “be the team boss” by choosing challenges for him to take part in each race weekend, sharing the results as the season goes on.

India, from the UK, describes herself as a “completely ordinary fan” looking to make next year “extraordinary” – and also asked other fans to set her fun challenges for each race, saying that winning would “bring together my two passions of F1 and seeing the world.”

Joy, whose home race in Singapore took place earlier this month, wants to use the opportunity to experience “the excitement and sportsmanship” of F1 around the world and to have a chance to “share the same passion” with those around her.

Jose, from the USA, is a fan not just of the racing but also of the strategy, technology and teamwork behind F1. He visited his home race in Las Vegas last year and said: “Travelling to every race in the 2027 would honestly be a dream come true.”

The opportunity to travel to every grand prix opens up unprecedented access to the sport and its fans. The current ticket holder Burgess has shown just how to get the best out of the experience this season and he was on the judging panel that picked the shortlist.

Speaking before the competition began, he said: “The key thing I'll be looking for is the passion for F1, because you have to be a true fan to make the most of this opportunity. It’s going to be hard to give it up and there’s quite a lot of pressure choosing who’s next.”

The competition was open to fans aged 25 or over, with entrants asked to name their favourite team and driver and select who they would take to a future race from a list of options provided by F1 and Heineken.

Fifty entrants were then selected at random and invited to submit a 90-second video on why they should become the next ticket holder – and the final six videos are now available to watch, so fans can determine who should win the adventure of a lifetime.

奥利·贝尔曼在驾驶艾尔顿·塞纳1985年的Lotus 97T赛车后，忍不住流下了眼泪，这辆赛车是塞纳首次赢得一级方程式赛车胜利的赛车。

"一级方程式作为一个整体，是一场巨大的竞争，"Komatsu说。"所以，你的第一个目标是击败你的队友。

Ayao Komatsu denies Haas are a Ferrari B team after Ferrari junior driver Rafael Camara signs alongside Ollie Bearman.
Haas boss Ayao Komatsu has dismissed the suggestion that his squad have become a "Ferrari B-team" after they confirmed the signing of a second driver from the Italian outfit's academy.
Haas announced on Thursday that 21-year-old Brazilian Rafael Camara will drive for them in 2027 after signing a multi-year contract.
Camara is set to drive alongside fellow Ferrari Driver Academy (FDA) product Oliver Bearman, with confirmation that the Brit will remain with Haas for a third season expected soon.

Haas' pairing of the two drivers, who both remain attached to Ferrari and retain ambitions of driving for the Italian team in future, furthers a strong working relationship between the two squads that also sees Ferrari supply Haas with power units and other significant parts.
Asked whether the signing of Camara could alter perceptions of Haas' identity, Komatsu said: "No, honestly, our collaboration with Ferrari gives us the access to those Ferrari Academy drivers.
Rafael Camara has signed a multi-year deal with Haas as Esteban Ocon's replacement.
"So, Ollie Bearman, because of our relationship with Ferrari, we had a chance to test him in Mexico (in 2024).
"And then because we got this relationship, we had a chance to test Rafa in Portimao.

"But it's the same as when we took Ollie. At no point Ferrari pressurised us, 'oh, Ayao, can you take Ollie because he's an FDA driver, he needs a race seat, or can you take Rafa because he's going to win F2 and he really needs to be in Formula 1?'
"None of that. We choose drivers by ourselves completely, by myself and (team owner) Mr Gene Haas.
"So, yes, they are FDA drivers, their careers have been supported by Ferrari, but they are Haas F1 team drivers and we are under no obligation or pressure to take anyone from Ferrari.
"So that Ferrari B-team thing is just not even a starter."
A battle for a future Ferrari seat?
Komatsu also insists he has no concerns that a potentially intense contest between Bearman and Camara to impress Ferrari could become a problem for Haas.
While Charles Leclerc signed a multi-year contract extension with Ferrari earlier this year, it remains to be seen how many more years his team-mate Lewis Hamilton will continue in F1.
The seven-time world champion will turn 42 in January, while it's unclear whether his Ferrari contract stretches beyond the end of the 2027 season.
Ollie Bearman is reduced to tears after driving Ayrton Senna's 1985 Lotus 97T, the car Senna drove to his first-ever Formula 1 victory.
Whenever Ferrari do require a new driver, Bearman and Camara would be obvious contenders, which means the way things play out for them at Haas could be a decisive factor in their F1 futures.
"Formula 1, as a whole, is a huge competition," Komatsu said. "So, a team-mate is the first person you need to beat.
"But both of them, I think they will be really focused on how to get the best out of themselves.

"Because, again, sporting results, beating somebody else, it's not totally under your control. You could be having your best drive, but somebody else can out-drive you, and in the circumstances, you might get beaten.

"But that's not something you can control. What you can control is to get the best out of yourself, absolutely everything, from your team, from yourself. And I believe that's what both of those guys are going to be focused on.
"And both of those guys, both Rafa and Ollie, they are incredibly quick."
